collection.description: A father notices that his child has been unusually quiet since making a mistake during a village task.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a father, notices that his child has been unusually quiet since making a mistake during a village task. He knows the child expects a scolding. Instead, he sits nearby and waits until they are ready to talk.

choices.label: Share a Story About His Own Mistakes

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The child explains their mistake, and they work out how to repair it together.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The child is not ready to speak, so he offers company without pressing.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: His child laughs at the memory and feels less alone.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The child insists that his mistake was worse, and he listens rather than arguing.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The child leans into him and begins to cry with relief.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The child declines the hug; he respects that and stays close.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: They practice patiently, and the child gains confidence.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The second attempt also fails, but the father praises their persistence without pretending it succeeded.
